notes:
A compound covering three types of government authorization: ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧ (permission), ⟦{認可|にんか}→認可：05879_ninka⟧ (approval), and implicitly ⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧ (license). Frequently discussed in the context of bureaucratic regulation and deregulation in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {許認可|きょにんか}{権|けん}: authority to grant permits
- {許認可|きょにんか}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: permit/licensing procedures
- {許認可|きょにんか}⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧: permit and licensing system
- {許認可|きょにんか}⟦{行政|ぎょうせい}→行政：14122_gyousei⟧: regulatory administration
- {許認可|きょにんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}る→得る：02014_eru⟧: to obtain authorization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: permission, approval — a single act of granting permission
- ⟦{認可|にんか}→認可：05879_ninka⟧: authorization, accreditation — official recognition or approval
- ⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: license — a specific qualification to perform an activity

definitions.explanation: the various types of official government permissions, approvals, and licenses required to conduct certain activities or businesses

examples.japanese: {許認可|きょにんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{許認可|きょにんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Various permits and licenses are needed to open a restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{許認可|きょにんか}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{簡素化|かんそか}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
